items.label: 【Motion Sensor Stair Light】
items.value: When the motion sensor stair light detects sufficient darkness, the motion sensor will activate the illumination when motion is detected (sensing range: 5-16ft, sensing angle: 120°, sensing time: 20s)

items.label: 【Soft Warm Lighting】
items.value: The hallway light illuminates dark floors well, and the frosted shade is designed to soften the light so that it won't irritate your eyes even when suddenly lit up at night. Protect your loved ones and children from darkness and fear

items.label: 【Battery Operated Stair Light】
items.value: Battery operated stair light provide up to 4 months of soft lighting. Each light requires 3 AAA batteries for installation (batteries not included)

items.label: 【Easy to Install】
items.value: The Wireless closet lights comes with double sided adhesive pads, no need for hard wiring installation is quick and easy, you can install the Wireless closet lights its anywhere

items.label: 【Compatible Occasions】
items.value: LED sensor night lights are friendly nighttime helpers for young children and many people who are afraid of the dark. Ideal for cabinets, hallways, garages, kitchens, bathrooms, wall, nurseries and more

items.label: Please Note
items.value: If the stair light accidentally detaches from the wall, remove it immediately to prevent tripping hazards and contact us to report the situation. This model features a normally open motion sensor for automatic operation and does not include a physical switch to turn the motion sensor on or off. Single light dimensions: 1.57 x 2.55 x 0.70 inches.
